title: Do it yourself exercise
paragraphs: It‘s very common these days for people to have a gym regime. Whatever the drive behind it, whether health-related, performance-related or just plain vainglory, it is not uncommon for people to take some sort of regular exercise each week.

But if you’ve never done it before, what‘s the best way to go about it? Well, many people make use of using a PT - that’s a personal trainer. This might be because they‘re wet behind the ears or maybe they just don’t want the aggro of designing their own workout plan. A PT will create a bespoke plan for you based on your aims. They will tailor it to your current abilities and, better still, they will teach you how to move in a way that won‘t incapacitate you.

However, the trade-off of getting a PT is the cost. With the double whammy of paying for a PT and gym membership, the price of an hourly session can be steep. If you‘re strapped for cash, then regular sessions might be out of your budget.
So what’s left? Well, if you have the grit for it, you can make your own regime. It‘s relatively easy to do if you have the know-how. But before you do, here are some basic pointers.

First, keep your fitness goal in mind. Are you looking to slim down, bulk up, get shredded or increase your abilities? Whatever it is, make sure the things you choose to do are in pursuit of that goal. Next, do your research. These days, social media is chock-full of fitness videos and advice. Watch as many of these as possible, but make sure to be a little critical of them — everyone has a different physique and what works for one may not work for another. Finally, keep your feet on the ground. Be patient with yourself and set realistic goals — it takes at least three months to see any realistic body changes. And don‘t be overzealous — never work in pain — a good workout is difficult and challenging, but never painful. Pain means you are damaging yourself.

If nothing else, focus on calisthenics — these are the basic body movements which everyone can do anywhere, even at home. They include squats, push-ups, pull-ups and crunches, among other things. Do as many of one exercise as you can without stopping, and then try and repeat that number twice more — make sure you sweat, and don‘t forget to rest for a minute in between!

vocabulary.entry: vainglory [n.] /veɪnˈɡlɔːri/ 虚荣；自负 (书面语；旧式)
vocabulary.example: His vainglory made him unpopular with his colleagues.
vocabulary.translation: 他的自负使他在同事中不受欢迎。

vocabulary.entry: wet behind the ears [phr.] /wet bɪˈhaɪnd ði ɪəz/ 缺乏经验的；乳臭未干的 (口语)
vocabulary.example: He‘s still wet behind the ears and needs more training.
vocabulary.translation: 他还缺乏经验，需要更多培训。

vocabulary.entry: aggro [n.] /ˈæɡrəʊ/ 麻烦；挑衅 (英式口语；俚语)
vocabulary.example: I don’t want any aggro, so I‘ll just leave quietly.
vocabulary.translation: 我不想惹麻烦，所以我会安静地离开。

vocabulary.entry: bespoke [adj.] /bɪˈspəʊk/ 定制的；定做的 (英式英语；书面语)
vocabulary.example: He wore a bespoke suit made by a famous tailor.
vocabulary.translation: 他穿着一套著名裁缝定制的西装。

vocabulary.entry: incapacitate [v.] /ˌɪnkəˈpæsɪteɪt/ 使丧失能力；使伤残 (正式用语)
vocabulary.example: The injury incapacitated him for several months.
vocabulary.translation: 那次受伤使他几个月都无法正常活动。

vocabulary.entry: trade-off [n.] /ˈtreɪd ɒf/ 权衡；取舍
vocabulary.example: There is always a trade-off between cost and quality.
vocabulary.translation: 在成本和质量之间总是需要权衡。

vocabulary.entry: double whammy [n.] /ˌdʌbəl ˈwæmi/ 双重打击；双重负担 (口语)
vocabulary.example: Losing his job and getting sick at the same time was a double whammy.
vocabulary.translation: 同时失去工作和生病是双重打击。

vocabulary.entry: steep [adj.] /stiːp/ 过高的；不合理的 (口语)
vocabulary.example: The price of the new phone is too steep for me.
vocabulary.translation: 新手机的价格对我来说太高了。

vocabulary.entry: strapped for cash [phr.] /stræpt fɔː kæʃ/ 手头拮据；缺钱 (口语)
vocabulary.example: I can‘t go out tonight because I’m strapped for cash.
vocabulary.translation: 我今晚不能出去，因为我手头拮据。

vocabulary.entry: grit [n.] /ɡrɪt/ 毅力；勇气 (口语)
vocabulary.example: It takes grit to start your own business.
vocabulary.translation: 创业需要毅力。

vocabulary.entry: know-how [n.] /ˈnəʊ haʊ/ 诀窍；专门知识 (口语)
vocabulary.example: She has the know-how to fix computers.
vocabulary.translation: 她有修理电脑的专门知识。

vocabulary.entry: shredded [adj.] /ˈʃredɪd/ 肌肉线条明显的 (健身俚语；口语)
vocabulary.example: He worked out every day to get shredded.
vocabulary.translation: 他每天锻炼以练出肌肉线条。

vocabulary.entry: chock-full of [phr.] /ˌtʃɒk ˈfʊl əv/ 充满；塞满 (口语)
vocabulary.example: The suitcase was chock-full of clothes.
vocabulary.translation: 手提箱里塞满了衣服。

vocabulary.term: keep one‘s feet on the ground [phr.]
vocabulary.entry: keep one‘s feet on the ground [phr.] /kiːp wʌnz fiːt ɒn ðə ɡraʊnd/ 脚踏实地；保持清醒
vocabulary.example: Despite his success, he always keeps his feet on the ground.
vocabulary.translation: 尽管取得了成功，他总是保持脚踏实地。

vocabulary.entry: overzealous [adj.] /ˌəʊvəˈzeləs/ 过于热心的；狂热的
vocabulary.example: The overzealous fan followed the celebrity everywhere.
vocabulary.translation: 这位狂热的粉丝到处跟随那位名人。

vocabulary.entry: calisthenics [n.] /ˌkælɪsˈθenɪks/ 徒手健身操 (美式英语)
vocabulary.example: Calisthenics exercises include push-ups and squats.
vocabulary.translation: 徒手健身练习包括俯卧撑和深蹲。

vocabulary.entry: in pursuit of [phr.] /ɪn pəˈsjuːt əv/ 追求；寻求
vocabulary.example: He moved to London in pursuit of a better career.
vocabulary.translation: 他搬到伦敦追求更好的职业。

vocabulary.entry: make use of [phr.] /meɪk juːz əv/ 利用；使用
vocabulary.example: We should make use of every opportunity to learn.
vocabulary.translation: 我们应该利用每一个学习的机会。

vocabulary.entry: tailor to [phr.] /ˈteɪlə tuː/ 使适应；为……量身定制
vocabulary.example: The course is tailored to the needs of beginners.
vocabulary.translation: 这门课程是根据初学者的需求设置的。

vocabulary.entry: out of one‘s budget [phr.] /aʊt əv wʌnz ˈbʌdʒɪt/ 超出某人的预算
vocabulary.example: A luxury car is out of my budget.
vocabulary.translation: 豪华车超出了我的预算。

sentences.english: It‘s very common these days for people to have a gym regime.
sentences.chinese: 如今，人们制定健身计划是很常见的事。

sentences.english: Whatever the drive behind it, whether health-related, performance-related or just plain vainglory, it is not uncommon for people to take some sort of regular exercise each week.
sentences.chinese: 无论背后的驱动力是什么，是与健康相关、与运动表现相关，还是仅仅出于虚荣，人们每周进行某种定期锻炼并不罕见。

sentences.english: But if you’ve never done it before, what‘s the best way to go about it?
sentences.chinese: 但如果你以前从未进行过健身，最好的方法是什么呢？

sentences.english: Well, many people make use of using a PT - that’s a personal trainer.
sentences.chinese: 嗯，很多人会聘请PT，也就是个人健身教练。

sentences.english: This might be because they‘re wet behind the ears or maybe they just don’t want the aggro of designing their own workout plan.
sentences.chinese: 这可能是因为他们缺乏经验，或者也许他们只是不想自己设计健身计划那么麻烦。

sentences.english: A PT will create a bespoke plan for you based on your aims.
sentences.chinese: 私人教练会根据你的目标为你制定一个量身定制的计划。

sentences.english: They will tailor it to your current abilities and, better still, they will teach you how to move in a way that won‘t incapacitate you.
sentences.chinese: 他们会根据你目前的能力进行定制，更好的是，他们会教你如何以一种不会让你受伤的方式进行运动。

sentences.english: However, the trade-off of getting a PT is the cost.
sentences.chinese: 然而，请私人教练的弊端在于费用。

sentences.english: With the double whammy of paying for a PT and gym membership, the price of an hourly session can be steep.
sentences.chinese: 考虑到既要支付私人教练的费用，又要支付健身房的会员费这种双重负担，每小时的课程费用可能会很昂贵。

sentences.english: If you‘re strapped for cash, then regular sessions might be out of your budget.
sentences.chinese: 如果你手头拮据，那么定期的课程可能会超出你的预算。

sentences.english: So what’s left?
sentences.chinese: 那么还有什么选择呢？

sentences.english: Well, if you have the grit for it, you can make your own regime.
sentences.chinese: 嗯，如果你有毅力，你可以制定自己的健身计划。

sentences.english: It‘s relatively easy to do if you have the know-how.
sentences.chinese: 如果你具备专业知识，做起来会相对容易。

sentences.english: But before you do, here are some basic pointers.
sentences.chinese: 但在你开始之前，这里有一些基本的要点。

sentences.english: First, keep your fitness goal in mind.
sentences.chinese: 首先，要牢记你的健身目标。

sentences.english: Are you looking to slim down, bulk up, get shredded or increase your abilities?
sentences.chinese: 你是想减肥、增肌、练出肌肉线条还是提高你的能力呢？

sentences.english: Whatever it is, make sure the things you choose to do are in pursuit of that goal.
sentences.chinese: 无论目标是什么，确保你选择做的事情是为了追求这个目标。

sentences.english: Next, do your research.
sentences.chinese: 其次，做些研究。

sentences.english: These days, social media is chock-full of fitness videos and advice.
sentences.chinese: 如今，社交媒体上充满了健身视频和建议。

sentences.english: Watch as many of these as possible, but make sure to be a little critical of them — everyone has a different physique and what works for one may not work for another.
sentences.chinese: 尽可能多地观看这些内容，但要确保对它们保持一定的批判性——每个人的体质都不同，对一个人有效的方法可能对另一个人却并不适用。

sentences.english: Finally, keep your feet on the ground.
sentences.chinese: 最后，要脚踏实地。

sentences.english: Be patient with yourself and set realistic goals — it takes at least three months to see any realistic body changes.
sentences.chinese: 对自己要有耐心，设定现实的目标——至少需要三个月才能看到身体有任何明显的变化。

sentences.english: And don‘t be overzealous — never work in pain — a good workout is difficult and challenging, but never painful.
sentences.chinese: 而且不要过于狂热——绝不要在疼痛的情况下锻炼——一次好的锻炼是困难且具有挑战性的，但绝不是痛苦的。

sentences.english: Pain means you are damaging yourself.
sentences.chinese: 疼痛意味着你在伤害自己。

sentences.english: If nothing else, focus on calisthenics — these are the basic body movements which everyone can do anywhere, even at home.
sentences.chinese: 如果没有别的选择，那就专注于徒手健身——这些是每个人在任何地方都能做的基本身体动作，甚至在家里也可以。

sentences.english: They include squats, push-ups, pull-ups and crunches, among other things.
sentences.chinese: 它们包括深蹲、俯卧撑、引体向上和仰卧起坐等等。

sentences.english: Do as many of one exercise as you can without stopping, and then try and repeat that number twice more — make sure you sweat, and don‘t forget to rest for a minute in between!
sentences.chinese: 尽可能多地不间断地做一种运动，然后再尝试重复同样的次数两次——确保你出汗了，而且不要忘记在中间休息一分钟！
